messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I have plans to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon-so I pray my knee cooperates.

output.original_text: I have plans to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon-so I pray my knee cooperates.
output.joy: I’m so excited to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon; I really hope my knee is ready for it!
output.sadness: I had hoped to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon, but I can’t help but worry that my knee will let me down again.
output.fear: I really want to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon, but I’m so anxious about whether my knee will cooperate.
output.anger: I made plans to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon, and it’s so frustrating that I have to worry about my knee holding me back!
output.surprise: I can’t believe I actually have plans to walk tomorrow in the late afternoon—I just hope my knee surprises me and cooperates!
output.disgust: I dread walking tomorrow in the late afternoon if my knee decides to act up again—it’s so frustrating.
